snippet.title: Vertebreaker Kickstarter Demo Trailer
snippet.description:
[On Hold] The game is currently on hold, as it's a very ambitious project that cannot be fully realized without the proper resources.

Vertebreaker is a comically-"spooky" action platformer that is still in early development. The technical preview and a subsequent demo, both for Windows, are available at the following links:

http://www.headcannon.com/data/Vertebreaker-Preview.rar
http://www.headcannon.com/data/Vertebreaker-Demo.zip

Unfortunately, it will be a while before we can come back to this project, but please enjoy what we've done so far.

These demos were created with (a very early version of) our own Methyl game engine:
https://www.headcannon.com/tech/methyl.html

Development of Methyl and our other independent efforts can be supported through our Patreon:
https://www.patreon.com/c/Headcannon

Visit our website:
http://www.headcannon.com

Join the discussion on Discord:
https://t.co/26dgTfBWti

Follow us on Twitter, Bluesky, and Facebook:
https://twitter.com/Head_cannon
https://bsky.app/profile/headcannon.bsky.social
https://www.facebook.com/Headcannon-117031702326433
